description.value: Wolf Brewing Company is a small-batch craft brewery and taproom (The Wolf Den) located just off the edge of downtown Nanaimo, close to the ferry terminals and Nanaimo Airport. The taproom pours 10+ taps of flagships and limited releases alongside signature 'Mash' pizzas made from spent brewing grain. A dog-friendly patio, regular live music nights, and growler fill service make it a welcoming destination for cyclists exploring Vancouver Island.

address.value: #2-940 Old Victoria Road, Nanaimo, BC V9R6Z8
